clips.title: The story
paras: The Black Feather Quill lies in Ban'ethil Barrow Den, needed to wake the Druids of the Talon.

The Black Feather Quill is one of four sacred focuses used to wake the Druids of the Talon from hibernation. The others are the Raven Claw Talisman, the Sapphire of Sky, and the Rune of Nesting. The rite calls slumbering druids back from the Emerald Dream. Without these items, a druid may remain trapped in the Dream and unable to return to their waking body.

Corrupted Gnarlpine furbolgs overran Ban'ethil Barrow Den, putting the chests that held the relics in danger. Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar ordered their swift recovery, before the captive druids were lost to the Dream.
